style.motion: slow easing, soft lighting, restrained camera movement

shots.prompt: Animate the supplied StockSheet icon on an ivory studio background with a slow, gentle camera approach. Keep the icon geometry unchanged. Use soft emerald reflected light and a premium minimal software launch aesthetic. Add one subtle shadow and restrained depth. No generated text, no extra logos, no exaggerated effects. 5 seconds, 16:9, 30 fps.

Create a premium minimal software product demo transition between real StockSheet UI frames. Use a calm fade, subtle camera drift, and soft emerald accents on an ivory background. Keep the UI content anchored to real app screens and avoid generating new labels or controls. 3 seconds, 16:9, 30 fps.

The same StockSheet icon settles into the center of an ivory background with generous negative space and a soft shadow. Use slow easing, elegant micro-motion, and premium minimal motion design. Keep the icon unchanged and avoid any generated text. 5 seconds, 16:9, 30 fps.

finalTextOverlays: Your spreadsheet. Your inventory. In sync.
Start with an Excel or CSV file. Upload your sheet, then match its columns to your store.
Choose what to update, and select your inventory location.
Preview the changes before anything is applied.
Review unmatched rows and correct your sheet when needed.
When everything looks right, confirm your changes.
Follow the progress as StockSheet updates your inventory.
Open History to download your original spreadsheet or the results.
Inventory quantities only. Price updates cannot be undone automatically.
StockSheet. Less repetitive work. More control over your stock.
